description: Create an Airflow DAG for adtech_platform that processes the daily impressions dump using a compute path chosen by input size. The DAG should: (1) compute total bytes and row count of the day's input files and push them to XCom, (2) branch: under 5 GB go to 'process_pandas' on a KubernetesPodOperator, between 5 GB and 200 GB go to 'process_spark_small', above 200 GB go to 'process_spark_large', and zero files go to 'handle_missing_input', (3) all processing branches converge on 'validate_output' then 'publish'. 'handle_missing_input' must raise an alert and end the run as failed.
edge_cases: Boundary values: exactly 5 GB goes to spark_small, exactly 200 GB goes to spark_small (above 200 GB is strictly greater)
Zero input files must not route to the pandas branch just because 0 < 5 GB
XCom value pulled in the branch callable must be cast to int; templated XCom arrives as a string unless render_template_as_native_obj is set
handle_missing_input must raise AirflowFailException so the DAG run is marked failed, while validate_output is skipped
common_failure_modes: FM6: Size check ordered so that zero bytes satisfies the first condition and an empty dataset is published
FM6: String comparison of XCom byte counts ('900' > '5368709120') selects the wrong branch
FM7: validate_output with trigger_rule='all_done' runs and passes after the missing-input branch
